A load balancer can distribute requests between multiple servers using different strategies:
Round-robin: the load balancer forwards requests to each server in the pool in turn.

Least connections: the load balancer forwards requests to the server with the least number of
Least response time: the load balancer forwards requests to the server with the least response
Hashing: the load balancer forwards requests to the server based on a hash of the request (e.g.
